I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL backend to use the `database` and `password` connection kwargs instead of the deprecated `db` and `passwd` kwargs:

- Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6vasy8go/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L230) in [base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6vasy8go/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to set `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['password']`.
- Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6vasy8go/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L58) in [client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6vasy8go/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to check for `'database'` in `OPTIONS` before falling back to `'db'` and `NAME`.
